## XHelpers Pro 1.0.0
XHelpers Pro is the new name for DeskHelper Pro — the same direct-download Mac utility, now under its own identity. If you were running DeskHelper Pro, an update will move you to XHelpers Pro automatically and carry your settings across.
**In this release** - Rebranded from DeskHelper Pro to XHelpers Pro (new app identity and update feed). - All existing features are unchanged: mirrored-display blackout, brightness/contrast and keyboard-backlight control, window arrangement and the active-window highlight, per-app audio, pointer and scroll tuning, and the Finder context-menu actions.
